high_level_description: This image is a fashion photograph featuring a model posing dynamically against a plain gray background. The model is wearing a flowing white dress with a large, vibrant red poppy flower printed on the side. The dress has a one-shoulder design, and the model's hair is styled in loose waves that are being blown by the wind, adding a sense of movement to the image. The model is striking a confident pose with one hand on her hip and the other arm extended outward. She is also wearing gold sandals, which complement the overall look.
